description: Per-collection MCP server settings. Used as a card sub-schema on the collection meta. Controls whether the collection is exposed to AI agents via /mcp and how it appears to them.
formgrid:
access access
description description
resource resource
tools tools

id.label: ID
id.help: Reserved — required by the schema system but unused for cards.

access.label: MCP Access
access.help: Controls who can call MCP content tools (query_collection, get_object, search_collection, describe_collection) against this collection. Admin: only callers with a valid API key. Public: anonymous AI agents can read this collection.

description.label: AI Description
description.help: Description shown to AI agents in list_collections and tool descriptions. Falls back to the collection's general description if blank. Write for AI consumption — what is this collection, what kind of objects does it contain, what makes it distinct.
description.placeholder: e.g. Blog posts published on the site. Includes featured posts, drafts, and archived content.

resource.label: Expose as MCP Resource
resource.help: When enabled, objects in this collection are addressable via tcms://{collection}/{id} URIs that AI clients can subscribe to.

tools.label: Custom MCP Tools
tools.help: Define saved-query tools as a JSON array. Each entry needs a name and description; optional params, filters, and other settings shape the query. See the docs for syntax and examples.
